steps.label: docker
steps.cmd: apt-get update && apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2

steps.label: up
steps.cmd: docker rm -f spawnables-vaultwarden >/dev/null 2>&1; docker run -d --restart unless-stopped --name spawnables-vaultwarden -p 8222:8222 -v /opt/spawnables-services/vaultwarden:/data vaultwarden/server:latest

notes: bitwarden-compatible server in one container (rust, no bitwarden cloud account). this is the vault the credential plane points at: bw cli or the web vault lives behind localhost:8222, so an owner's logins never need to be typed into a guest by hand and the guest can reach them only through the proxy. signups are off by default in the image, so enabling a new account is an explicit step on the owner's card, not something a guest can do to itself.
